title: A relationship has an exact address.

steps.title: Find the referencing field
steps.description: The task stores agent_id. This field carries the relationship; the entire tasks table is not the address.

steps.title: Follow it to an identity
steps.description: The arrow points to the id field of agents. Multiple tasks can reference that same primary key.

steps.title: Read the line as a constraint
steps.description: This line represents a reference between fields. A data-flow arrow would make a different claim. The annotation preserves that distinction.
